title: Pearl Street Station and the start of electrification
summary: On September 4, 1882, Thomas Edison's Pearl Street Station in New York City became the first commercial central electric power station in the United States. It stayed in operation until a fire partially destroyed it in January 1890. This outline covers the station; the wider electrification of homes and industry still needs its own record.
